title: C05: Complete or disposition hybrid particle-population execution

source.contract: Complete particle-population hybrid execution: whole-complex conversion, population count updates, reverse conversion without changing transition rates, mapped rates, observables, conservation, and generate_hybrid_model actions.

oracle.identity: Pinned BNG2 hybrid transformation, pinned native NFsim, and exact analytic binomial/conservation continuous-time Markov chain laws
oracle.law: Pure-death and reversible two-state CTMC analytical distributions, exact particle and molecule conservation laws (A_total + B_total = N, dimer A_units = 2*N), and 4.0-sigma stochastic agreement between native NFsim and BNG3.
